Implemented **Apex Tower**, an animated 3D multi-floor office building simulation that runs directly in the browser from a `file://` URL using classic `<script>` tags with no build process, ES modules, or external network dependencies.

### Files Created
- `index.html` — Entry point with classic script tags, HUD controls (time/speed, time-of-day jumps, facade view modes, camera presets, floor focus, elevator bank status, worker/elevator inspector, and building log).
- `styles.css` — Glassmorphic UI overlay styling for the HUD, inspector, and controls.
- `js/math.js` — 3D vector and 4x4 matrix math (`Vec3`, `Mat4`), interpolation helpers, seeded PRNG, and ray-AABB unprojection for 3D picking.
- `js/webgl.js` — Custom WebGL 3D renderer with Blinn-Phong + hemisphere + indoor glow lighting, distance fog, procedural offscreen-canvas textures (`carpet`, `marble`, `wood`, `grass`, `asphalt`, `brick`, `glassGrid`), and two-pass opaque/transparent rendering.
- `js/world.js` — 6-floor office building and outdoor city environment:
  - **Outdoors**: Time-of-day sky & sun cycle (dawn through night), paved street with lane markings and crosswalk, animated cars with night headlights, plaza fountain, benches, trees, streetlamps, and surrounding city skyline.
  - **Indoors**: Floor 1 Lobby & Cafe (reception desk, security turnstiles, waiting lounge, espresso bar), Floor 2 Engineering (dual-monitor desks, server racks), Floor 3 Design Studio, Floor 4 Sales & glass-walled Conference Room, Floor 5 Finance & Breakroom (kitchenette, fridge, water cooler, dining tables), Floor 6 Executive Suite & open-air Rooftop Terrace, plus central stairwell and twin elevator shafts.
- `js/simulation.js` — High-fidelity office & elevator simulation:
  - **Twin Elevator Bank (`A` & `B`)**: LOOK/SCAN-style hall call assignment, smooth acceleration/deceleration, sliding doors, alighting-before-boarding logic, and 6-person capacity.
  - **26 Named Workers**: Daily arrival/departure schedules, corridor-aware waypoint navigation, stair vs. elevator choices for 1-floor trips, desk work with typing animation, scheduled F4 conference room meetings, coffee/lunch breaks with held coffee cups, and articulated 3D limb animations.
- `js/main.js` — Orbit/pan/zoom camera with smooth damping, camera presets, floor focusing, worker-follow mode, 3D raycast picking, and live HUD updates.

### Verification
- Verified JavaScript syntax across all five scripts with `node -c js/math.js && node -c js/webgl.js && node -c js/world.js && node -c js/simulation.js && node -c js/main.js` (`ALL JS SYNTAX OK`).{"type":"agent_end","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"","sections":{"preamble":"You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. i++) {\n      if (h >= keys[i].h && h <= keys[i + 1].h) {\n        k0 = keys[i]; k1 = keys[i + 1]; break;\n      }\n    }\n    var t = (k1.h === k0.h) ? 0 : M.smoothstep(k0.h, k1.h, h);\n    var elev isNight: h < 6.3 || h > 18.6\n    };\n  }\n\n  function World() {\n    this.viewMode = 'glass'; // 'glass' | 'cutaway' | 'xray'\n    this.focusFloor = 0;     // 0 = all, 1..6 = specific floor\n    this.cars = [\n      { x: -32, z: 17.5, dir: 1, speed: 9.5, color: [0.78, 0.22, 0.20], len: 4.0 },\n      { x: 18,  z: 17.5, dir: 1, speed: 8.2, color: [0.22, 0.38, 0.62], len: 4.2 },\n      { x: 26, [32, 8],\n      [-36, 34],  [-16, 36],  [6, 35],   [26, 34]\n    ];\n    for (var i = 0; i < spots.length; i++) {\n      this.cityBlocks.push({\n        x: spots[i][0] + (rng() - 0.5) * 3,\n        z: World.prototype.update = function (dt) {\n    for (var i = 0; i < this.cars.length; i++) {\n      var c = this.cars[i];\n      c.x += c.dir * c.speed * dt;\n      if (c.dir > 0 && c.x > 46) c.x = -46;\n      if (c.dir < 0 && c.x < -46) c.x = 46;\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Furniture Helpers\n  function drawDesk(r, x, y, z, rotY, hasDualMonitor, glow, screenActive) {\n    // Desk top\n    r.drawBox(x, y + 0.74, z, 1.5, 0.06, 0.75, { color: COL.deskTop, tex: 'wood', ry: rotY, indoorGlow: glow });\n    // Legs\n    var cos = Math.cos(rotY), sin = Math.sin(rotY);\n    var lx = 0.68, lz = 0.30;\n [0.95, 0.9, 0.6] : [0, 0, 0]\n      });\n      r.drawBox(hx, 0.45, car.z + 0.55, 0.06, 0.16, 0.26, {\n        color: [1, 0.96, 0.8],\n        emissive: env.isNight ? [0.95, 0.9, 0.6] : [0, 0, 0]\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Background City Skyline\n    for (var bi = 0; bi < this.cityBlocks.length; bi++) {\n      var b = this.cityBlocks[bi];\n      r.drawBox(b.x, b.h * 0.5, b.z, b.w, b.h, b.d, {\n        color: [b.shade, b.shade + 0.03, b.shade + 0.08],\n        tex: 'brick',\n        uvX: 2,\n        uvY: Math.round(b.h / 4),\n        emissive: env.isNight ?
